situation: The customer is at the counter of the small post office on the town's main street. There is a scale for packages on the counter and a wall of PO boxes.
facts: A stamp for a letter is $1. Sending a package is $5.
The staff member on duty weighs every package on the scale before sending it.
The post office is between Maple Bakery and Home & Living. Little Arcade is right across the main street.
This business is open 24 hours, with staff changing shifts. The current staff member can provide the services described here.
